description: PRE-REGISTERED (2026-10-24) BEFORE any run, docs/reports/RW-reescritura-rentable.md §16.17 (quorum Q5 question 4, first choice; criteria O1, O2, T1, T3-T6, scripts/rw5-crypto-evaluate.ts --overlay; trial 454 -> 455). Q5 question 4 first choice: monthly symmetric price-return TSM on BTC/ETH, using momentum_crypto capital only while its normal long book is empty. Copy of the live momentum-crypto-rw3-vt-35-corroff-pure-v1 manifest with ONLY idleOverlay added to its candidate. No historical trial has been run. Price sign over 365 completed UTC days (not funding-adjusted excess return); normalized finite EWMA mean/variance of simple daily returns, delta=60/61, 610 returns (611 closes), annualization sqrt(365). Per-coin notional=equity*0.40/sigma, no division by N; cap 1x per coin and 1.5x basket, proportional gross clipping at entry (hold drift allowed). These are local adaptations, not a literal MOP replication. At the first decision of each UTC month close/re-size the overlay; skip a busy, risk-blocked or data-starved month, no intramonth entry/re-entry, fresh midmonth starts wait for the next month. Normal hourly longs have priority: close ALL overlay inventory successfully before any normal open. Overlay bypasses hourly regime/Sharpe/trend/volTarget/exposureControl, but respects maintenance, RiskGuard entry permission, ddScale if configured, sleeve gross cap and broker margin. No protective stop; hard sleeve drawdown closes overlay positions with IDLE_OVERLAY_EXIT. Funding/fees/slippage/liquidation modeled normally. The director approves these bounds and conventions in §16.17; acceptance copied unchanged. Trial 454 -> 455.
